stories.title: Trade Deadline — 4 Days Out, Skubal and Miller Both Likely Staying

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
The narrative is shifting.

Tarik Skubal — once the most coveted trade target — is now LIKELY STAYING in Detroit.

The Tigers are 10-4 in July and 4.5 games from a Wild Card spot.

August 3 deadline: 4 days away. 🔥

#Tigers #MLBDeadline

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Mason Miller update: Padres are "likely" keeping him.

0.84 ERA. 26 saves. NL-best.

The Yankees offered Spencer Jones + Jasson Dominguez. Padres said no.

4 days until the deadline. Miller ain't moving. 🔒

#Padres #Yankees #MLBDeadline

article.headline: Four Days to the Deadline — And Tarik Skubal Might Not Be Going Anywhere

stories.title: Kyle Schwarber — On Pace for 72, the Most Historic HR Season in Decades

x_posts.label: Post 4-1
x_posts.text:
Kyle Schwarber has 33 HR and is projecting to finish the season with 72.

Barry Bonds' all-time record: 73.

First player to 20, 25, and 30 HR in 2026. Age 35. Six straight seasons of 30+.

What are we watching? 👀

#Phillies #Schwarber

x_posts.label: Post 4-2
x_posts.text:
The 60 HR club:
• Bonds: 73 (2001)
• McGwire: 70 (1998)
• Sosa: 66 (1998)
• Judge: 62 (2022)
• Maris: 61 (1961)

Kyle Schwarber (age 35) is on pace to join them.

That's the conversation we're having in 2026. 🤯

#Phillies #Schwarber

article.headline: Kyle Schwarber Is on Pace for 72 Home Runs. Barry Bonds Hit 73. Let That Sink In.
